games.name: Bubble Hockey
new: Body checks: bigger red check cone on the TV and phone, and checks knock the puck loose more often
Strong checks can knock a player down for under a second - he tips over, flashes, gets up and skates back to his spot
A stopped or crawling loose puck slowly drifts to the nearest player, so fewer dead pucks
Players are plain cylinders for now: the white wedge shows which way he's facing, the stick points at the puck
